name: Portal P-004 deployed artifact invariants and negative controls
summary: The durable verifier passed all nine R-1 through R-4 artifact assertions, including missing-destination, inverted-delta, missing-warm-journey, missing-metric, and failed-instrument controls.

assertions.evidence: All 34 artifact tabs matched all 34 PORTAL_APP_KINDS in order and uniquely; skipped was empty; the probe imports and spreads the contract.
Removing one tab from an in-memory artifact copy made the coverage predicate fail.
The tracked control-projection artifact measured 15 rows at 219,070 before and 17,558 after: 201,512 bytes and 92% removed through projectControlRows.
Making the after payload larger than before in an in-memory copy made the improvement predicate fail.
The 34-tab, repeats=3 artifact carries separate cold/warm metrics and states for every tab; warm correctly omits navigation-only FCP/LCP.
Removing one warm journey from an in-memory copy made the journey predicate fail.
All required cold/warm metrics are present; the 34-tab, five-cycle series has seven snapshots, VOID=false, and passing timer/EventSource/instrument controls.
Removing one cold firstContentfulPaint field from an in-memory copy made the metric predicate fail.
Turning instrumentPresent false in an in-memory series copy made the full-cycle predicate fail.
